svg.title: What you keep right by hand, and what the starter does for you
svg.desc: Manual formatting compared with this starter. When you type numbers and apply formatting by hand, you maintain them yourself. The starter updates numbering, cross-references, contents, citations, and shared styles when you compile. Structured styles and references can also automate work in other writing tools. You still check the final PDF.
